newsitem.title: INDIA: Maoist rebels kill at least eight people in India.
newsitem.headline: Maoist rebels kill at least eight people in India.

text.p: An outlawed Maoist rebel group shot dead at least eight people in India's eastern state of Bihar on Monday, the United News of India (UNI) said.
The news agency quoted officials as saying Maoist Communist Centre rebels kidnapped villagers travelling in a jeep in central Bihar, took them to a nearby hill and killed them.
Police have launched a sweeping search operation for the rebels in the region, UNI added. It gave no other details.

The Maoist Communist Centre is one of many groups that broke away from India's main communist party in the 1960s. It is fighting for a radical redistribution of Bihar's land from upper-caste landlords to low-caste peasants.
